verdict.rationale: Mailgun explicitly documents US/EU region choice for sending and receiving email (mailgun-docs-13), giving users basic data residency control, but there's no evidence of finer-grained data storage/residency controls, compliance certifications tied to region, or documentation on how region selection maps to full data storage guarantees. Missing for 10: detailed residency/compliance documentation (e.g., GDPR data-processing specifics per region), independent verification of region isolation, and any UI/API mechanism beyond basic account-level region selection.
